icon

Icon. The default length unit of component attributes is pixel.

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
type String Yes Icon type. The options are as follows: success, success_no_circle, info, info_circle, warn, waiting, cancel, download, search, and circle.
size Number/String 23 No Size of an icon, in pixels.
color String No Icon color, which is the same as the CSS color.

Sample Code


<view>
  <icon type='success' size='93'></icon>
</view>
